title: Study of Rota-Baxter Operators in Matrix $C^*$-Algebras Motivated by Toeplitz Structures, and Applications to Sliding Mode Control
summary: This paper studies Rota-Baxter operators on the matrix $C^*$-algebra $M_n(\mathbb{C})$, motivated by the discrete Toeplitz algebra (whose role is purely heuristic; see Remark~\ref{rem:toeplitz_scope}). We provide a structural classification of such operators compatible with the $C^*$-norm, analyze their induced Lie brackets, and apply them to deform system matrices in discrete-time delayed systems under sliding mode control.
